# Site A selection

Vendor: Kestrel (V2).
Deciding constraint: the unit is rated to -20 °C, below the -12 °C design minimum, and is 900 mm wide, within the 1200 mm limit. The table has no 2026 coastal row; site A has no coastal requirement.
